simple.summary: אַמָּה (ʼAmmâh) means Ammah , a hill in Palestine First listed occurrence: 2Sam 2 24.

definitions.full: H522. Ammah I. אַמָּה noun feminine only mother-city, metropolis (compare אֵם 2Sam 20:19 & Phoenician); in phrase הָאַמָּה מֶתֶג authority of mother-city 8:1 ; see מֶתֶג ; compare Dr. IV. אַמָּה proper name, of a location hill near Gibeon , גִּבְעַתאַֿמָּה 2Sam 2:24 .
